name: rhongomiant-no-power-bonus-at-influence-seven
notes: Rhongomiant (clS3E0HrZL): the bonus needs influence EIGHT or more. Player 2's hand is emptied and refilled with six cards, so after its turn-2 draw its influence (hand + memory) is exactly 7: the Mordred Bonus is active but the weapon keeps its printed power 2.

rulesClauses: The +4 POWER needs influence EIGHT or more (seven is not enough).
